report.summary: Ledger Database ran out of disk space, causing file extension errors during INSERT queries in ledger-service, which in turn caused payments-api to fail ledger writes and leave payments stuck in PENDING status.

supporting.note: Shows disk usage reached 100% saturation starting at 13:19
Ledger-db reported 'could not extend file' errors starting at 13:52
Ledger-service logged PostgreSQL 'No space left on device' errors on insert statements
Payments-api failed ledger writes and marked payments as PENDING for retry

contradicting.note: Payment-api errors started at 13:53, before the kyc deploy at 14:00
Ledger-service errors started at 13:52, before the kyc deploy at 14:00

facts.text: Ledger-db disk usage reached 100% and showed an anomaly starting at 2026-10-03T13:19:00+00:00
Ledger-service error rate and latency started increasing at 2026-10-03T13:52:00+00:00
Ledger-db logged 'could not extend file' errors starting at 2026-10-03T13:52:08+00:00
Ledger-service logged PostgreSQL 'No space left on device' errors starting at 2026-10-03T13:52:00+00:00
Payments-api error rate started increasing at 2026-10-03T13:53:00+00:00
Payments-api logged ledger write failures and marked payments as PENDING for retry starting at 2026-10-03T13:53:03+00:00

assumptions: Normal transaction volume and database growth over time naturally filled the storage volume allocated to ledger-db without timely log rotation or scaling.
evidence_gaps: Past incident search index was partially degraded, returning only top matches.

timeline.event: Ledger-db disk usage anomaly began rising toward 100%
Ledger-service began experiencing error rate and latency anomalies and logging 'No space left on device' errors
Ledger-db reported file extension failures due to lack of disk space
Payments-api error rate increased and marked payments as PENDING for retry
Incident INC-02 officially reported by payments on-call

recommended_actions.action: Provision additional disk space or expand storage volume for ledger-db
recommended_actions.rationale: Resolves the 'No space left on device' condition allowing database writes to succeed again

recommended_actions.action: Implement background worker to retry and complete payments stuck in PENDING status
recommended_actions.rationale: Ensures customer transactions that debited users are properly processed and recorded

recommended_actions.action: Set up critical disk usage alerting on ledger-db
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents unexpected disk saturation by warning engineering teams early

recommended_actions.action: Review database retention, cleanup, and storage scaling policies for ledger-db

gaps: search_past_incidents(query=No space left on device) returned partial data
